model: Emotion Aware Voice Assistant configured backend (Groq GPT-OSS 120B; Groq Whisper large-v3-turbo for Spoken SQuAD audio)
sampling: fixed-seed random sample per accessible dataset; sample sizes vary by free-tier constraints

triviaqa.metric_note: Exact-match and token-F1 proxies; SOVA paper used GPT-evaluated accuracy.

librisqa.metric_note: Four-choice accuracy; evaluated cascade-style from prior ASR transcripts.

alpaca.metric_note: Text-only lexical proxies; not paper GPTScore, consistency WER, or UTMOSv2.

spoken_squad.metric_note: Exact-match and token-F1 proxies; SOVA paper used GPT-evaluated accuracy.

unmeasured_sova_cells.emotion_iemocap: Not run: IEMOCAP access files are not available locally; paper requires its 5-way label mapping.
unmeasured_sova_cells.age_common_voice: Not run: the assistant has no age-prediction output; Common Voice source needs authorized download.
unmeasured_sova_cells.gender_common_voice: Not run: the assistant has no gender-prediction output; Common Voice source needs authorized download.
unmeasured_sova_cells.alpaca_speech_consistency_and_acoustic: Not run in this text pass: TTS/UTMOSv2 would require speech generation and additional runtime/credits.
unmeasured_sova_cells.paper_baseline_models: Published paper values are references only; baseline checkpoints were not run locally.
